visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, brownish hair and a large orange-yellow marigold crown is seen in a close-up shot as a person off-screen applies white makeup to her face using a brush. The background shows posters with Day of the Dead themes. (2) The camera shifts to a medium shot as the woman, now with intricate black and red skull patterns painted on her white-face base, stands in a crowded outdoor street. She is wearing a black tank top and a long, pleated, reddish-brown skirt, spinning around to showcase her full costume and makeup under bright, natural daylight. (3) The setting changes to a well-lit indoor kitchen with patterned tiles. The woman holds a small white pouch with blue lettering close to the camera, then proceeds to squeeze a white creamy substance onto her hand. She applies the cream to the right side of her painted face, rubbing it in circular motions with her fingers. (4) The woman uses a white tissue to wipe off the dissolved makeup, revealing clean skin on half of her face while the other half remains fully painted. She holds the stained tissue up to the lens to demonstrate the removal effect, expressing surprise through wide eyes and an open mouth.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video moves from a temporary makeup booth decorated with posters, to a busy metropolitan street with trees and high-rise buildings, and finally to a domestic kitchen with detailed Moroccan-style backsplash tiles.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with upbeat, rhythmic electronic BGM at approximately 124 BPM. A female voice speaks with high arousal and a cheerful tone, describing a past trip to Mexico. (2) A subtle acoustic shift occurs as a 'whoosh' sound effect transitions into the indoor kitchen environment. The voice changes from narration to a direct-to-camera address, maintaining a fast speech rate and high pitch while introducing a cleansing product. (3) A distinct 'click' and 'squelch' sound of liquid being squeezed from a pouch marks the start of the demonstration phase. The BGM continues steadily in the background while the voice becomes more expressive, featuring high-pitched laughter and melodic rising intonations. (4) Frequent 'swiping' and 'rustling' sounds of tissues and fingers rubbing against skin are audible. The voice peaks in intensity, shouting 'Incredible' and 'OMG' with high spectral brightness and clarity, concluding the product trial.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Experience -> Challenge -> Solution -> Demonstration -> Outcome
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote SPOCOCO's cleansing essence by demonstrating its high efficacy in removing heavy, oil-based theatrical makeup. By contrasting the intense Day of the Dead face paint with the ease of removal using the product, the creator builds credibility and visual proof for the brand's performance.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator explicitly holds the product to the camera, names the brand 'SPOCOCO', and provides a step-by-step tutorial on how to use it for heavy makeup removal.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively utilizes the 'Day of the Dead' theme as a high-contrast backdrop for a beauty product demonstration, combining travel vlog elements with a professional marketing hook.
